field_principles.status: Records the terminal V564 capstone state after reading all expected artifacts.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Summarizes mixed evidence without converting missing, null, or blocked rows into success.
field_principles.verdict_class: Uses partial for mixed lineage outcomes, positive only for oracle-distinct row-supported claims, and blocked or disqualified for missing or unsafe evidence.
field_principles.task_inventory_rows: One row per expected task records path, hash, status, class, gate field, observed value, row support, authority, and eligibility.
field_principles.artifact_hash_receipts: Content hashes prove which files were read and which expected deliverables were missing.
field_principles.gate_contract_rows: Checks downstream gate field spelling against upstream artifacts and the V564 roadmap.
field_principles.retired_scope_audit: Proves structured dependencies do not name retired Exp6506 through Exp6511 task ids.
field_principles.transaction_audit: Audits Exp6516 direct immutable inputs and Exp6514 shard/final transaction receipts.
field_principles.data_integrity_audit: Recomputes row counts, terminal dispositions, all-null risk, denominators, and protected null or blocked outcomes.
field_principles.exact_authority_audit: Confirms exact solver authority, candidate preservation, fallback, conflict witnesses, and safe durable writes.
field_principles.comparative_claim_rows: One row per claim records row support, denominator, authority, and eligibility.
field_principles.structural_headroom_decision: Carries the Exp6519 row-derived headroom result without using aggregate-only claims.
field_principles.learned_router_claim_eligible_score: Bare scalar set to one only when the learned-router claim has oracle-distinct row evidence and all acceptance conditions.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_claim_eligible_: Bare scalar set to one only when the independent full CSL audit supports held-future benefit safely.
field_principles.adaptive_validation_decision: Separates validation-cost saving from the CSL scientific claim.
field_principles.arc_generalization_decision: Preserves live-path receipt absence and blocks ARC solve credit.
field_principles.hardware_continuity_decision: Records GateMate command authorization, command count, and performance-claim absence.
field_principles.next_state_rows: One row per lineage picks only stop_null, retire_same_verdict, expand_after_positive, repair_broken_contract, or preserve_watch.
field_principles.discrepancy_rows: Names missing, blocked, contradictory, unsafe, or unsupported evidence without stopping the capstone.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Summarizes capstone gate checks, lineage blockers, and failed checks.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Flattens task, claim, gate, protected-file, and discrepancy rows for row lints.
field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Rebuilds headline scores, verdict class, and next states from rows.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records git status, date, expected deliverables, resources, source paths, and protected hashes.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Compares protected-file hashes before and after capstone construction.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares independent V564 artifact row and receipt synthesis with no LLM.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False for scientific value claims; exact self-check authority is disclosed separately.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each required field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps every field to artifact receipts, row reducers, specs, tests, or hashes.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins deterministic row ordering and checksum construction.
field_principles.tests_run: Records verification commands and exit codes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Detects drift in inputs, row reductions, decisions, and tests.
